Describe the caller-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Regression evidence

Apply [the minimum test quality bar](https://github.com/LongsightGroup/qti3/blob/main/docs/test-quality-bar.md). For each changed
contract, identify the decisive test assertion, the independent expected result, and the
pre-fix failure or targeted fault it detects. Group related parameterized cases together.
If tests were removed, identify retained coverage or explain why they proved no project contract.

## Validation

List completed checks and material gaps. Distinguish runtime, browser, schema, and compiler-only
evidence. A test count alone is not a validation argument.
